releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v6.1.0 Master Release:
- OmniNeural v3 Multi-Agent AI (350+ game process signatures, 64-sample AeroCore PID thermal prediction, Kalman derivative filtering)
- 5-Gauge Dashboard: Symmetrically balanced top row with fixed Battery ColorMode (green for full charge, red for low)
- Fixed Telemetry CSV export button layout & unobstructed canvas
- Zero-CPU WMI architecture with throttled EC writes and low-power C-states
- Multi-monitor external display protection on gaming laptops
- Universal DPI scaling and full smooth scroll support across all 9 views.
